representations.autocorrelation: Full positive-lag normalized curve; lag zero excluded.
representations.bands: Square roots of relative Welch band powers; all original physical bands.
representations.baseline: Historical full-band Welch (1024 samples), floor 1e-30, centered dB.
representations.distance: RMS per representation; medians over all cross-window pairs define each acquisition-pair distance. Classes each contribute three acquisition groups.
representations.envelope: Full broadband envelope spectrum divided by mean envelope.
representations.extension_lines: Full physical curves; estimators individually dB-centered, spacing histogram normalized; carrier envelopes already mean-relative.
representations.fft: 8192 pooled linear-power bins excluding DC, relative -80 dB floor, centered dB.
representations.levels: RMS and peak empirical quantiles; no phase-aligned raw-waveform distance.
representations.masks: Intersect finite coordinates across this exploratory dataset without labels; less than 20% common support is unavailable. This is transductive coverage, not a fully prospective learned-pipeline evaluation.
representations.other_maps: All physical cells of cyclic, filter-bank kurtosis and carrier/modulation maps, with missing cells preserved. No frequency-axis averaging.
representations.persistence: 10/50/90% PSD-level quantiles from each frequency histogram on its actual dB axis, then centered; never compare record-dependent histogram row indices.
representations.ridge: 101 empirical quantiles in Hz; no matching of arbitrary event times.
representations.spectral_kurtosis: Exact 10 Hz physical grid; unmeasured frequency bins are NaN.
representations.stft: Per-frequency 10/50/90% temporal quantiles of centered relative-floor dB PSD.
representations.temporal_maps: Physical STFT/reassigned/wavelet retain each frequency's 10/50/90% time quantiles after global dB centering; chronology is not retained.
representations.welch: 1024-sample Welch, relative -80 dB floor, centered dB; native frequency grid.

scope: Descriptive labeled stability screen; previously consumed acquisitions; Jin direction and Ottawa profile/load contexts, not independent-machine validation.
selection: All48 existing extended-study recordings; no outcome-based subsetting.
